remarks: Charming 4-Bedroom Home in Desirable Stamford Location   Welcome to your dream home in one of Stamford's most sought-after neighborhoods nestled right on the border of picturesque New Canaan, CT. This beautifully maintained 4-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom single-family home offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and classic New England charm.  Step inside to find a spacious and light-filled layout, ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. The updated kitchen features modern appliances and ample cabinet space, while the inviting living room boasts hardwood floors and a cozy fireplace. The main level also includes a versatile bedroom or home office, perfect for today's flexible lifestyle.  Upstairs, you'll find four generously sized bedrooms + Bonus Room with abundant closet space, along with a tastefully renovated full bathroom. Outside, enjoy your private backyard oasis perfect for summer barbecues, gardening, or simply relaxing under the mature trees.  Highlights Include:  4 spacious bedrooms, 2.5 full bathrooms  Bonus Room w/ Half bath  Updated kitchen and bathrooms  Hardwood floors throughout  Private backyard and patio  Attached garage and ample driveway parking  Quiet, family-friendly street  Minutes from New Canaan shops, Metro-North, schools, and parks  Enjoy the best of both worlds with Stamford's convenience and amenities, combined with the charm and prestige of New Canaan living just moments away. Don't miss this rare opportunity
